text:
## Contributing

No pull request merges to main with fewer than two approving reviews from other engineers. A single approval is enough for feature branches that don't deploy directly. Reviewers should focus on correctness and test coverage, not style -- that's what the linter is for.

expected.description: PRs need two approvals before merging to main
Feature branches that don't deploy directly need only one approval
Code review should focus on correctness and test coverage, not style

text:
Standard refunds

Customers on any self-serve plan can request a full refund within 14 days of their original charge. After day 14, point them to the cancel-instead-of-refund flow. Manager sign-off can override this in exceptional cases, but that should be rare.

expected.description: Standard refund window is 14 days from purchase
After the 14-day window, direct customers to cancel instead of refund
Manager can override standard refund policy in exceptional cases

text:
Incident response decision (2026-03-02)

We agreed: any incident classified SEV1 -- full outage or data loss risk -- must page the on-call engineer within 5 minutes of detection, day or night. The page fires automatically off the severity classification; nobody should be manually deciding whether to wake someone up.

expected.description: SEV1 incidents page on-call within 5 minutes

text:
## CI

Every pull request needs a green build, passing tests, and a passing lint job before it's mergeable to main. Branch protection enforces this -- it is not reviewer-discretionary, and a reviewer cannot approve around a red CI check.

expected.description: CI checks must pass before a PR can merge

text:
Receipts

Any individual expense line over $50 needs an attached receipt in the expense report. Anything at or under that threshold can be submitted without one. This applies to every expense category, not just travel, and finance spot-checks a sample of under-threshold lines each quarter.

expected.description: Receipts required for expenses over $50
Finance spot-checks a sample of under-threshold expense lines each quarter

text:
Vendor security decision

Before signing any contract with a vendor that will process or store customer data, security has to complete a review and sign off first. This applies even to short pilot engagements -- there's no fast path that skips the review just because the initial contract is small.

expected.description: New vendors touching customer data require a security review before signing

text:
## Git conventions

Force pushing to main, staging, or any branch other engineers have already pulled is prohibited -- it silently discards their commits. Force push is only allowed on a branch you own exclusively and haven't shared yet.

expected.description: Never force push to a shared branch like main

text:
Enterprise SLA

Tickets from accounts on the enterprise plan carry a 2-hour first-response SLA instead of the standard 4-hour one, and route directly to the dedicated enterprise queue rather than the general pool. This applies to every ticket regardless of severity.

expected.description: Enterprise tickets get a 2-hour response SLA
Enterprise tickets route directly to the dedicated enterprise queue

text:
Data export decision

Any bulk export of customer data -- for debugging, analytics, or a customer request -- needs a support or engineering manager's approval logged before the export runs. This applies regardless of how the data will end up being used afterward.

expected.description: Customer data exports require manager approval

text:
## Rollouts

Ship risky changes behind a feature flag starting at 10% of traffic, doubling every 48 hours if error rates stay flat, before going to 100%. Skip the ramp only for a hotfix to an already-broken feature.

expected.description: New features roll out behind a flag starting at 10%, doubling every 48 hours
Skip the gradual rollout ramp only for a hotfix to an already-broken feature

text:
Admin access

Every account with admin-level access to production systems or customer data must have multi-factor authentication enabled before it's granted access. An admin account without MFA gets suspended automatically after a 7-day grace period.

expected.description: MFA required for admin accounts, 7-day grace period before suspension
Admin-level access requires MFA enabled before access is granted

text:
Support escalation decision

If a customer mentions a lawsuit, subpoena, or regulator in a support conversation, stop responding substantively and loop in the legal team the same business day. Never admit fault or promise a specific remedy before legal weighs in.

expected.description: Legal threats from a customer escalate to legal the same day
Never admit fault or promise a remedy before legal review

text:
## Staging gate

Every deploy goes to staging first and needs a smoke test pass there before promoting to production, no exceptions for small changes. Hotfixes for an active incident are the only case that can skip the staging gate, and only with a second engineer's sign-off in the incident channel.

expected.description: Deploys go through staging first; hotfixes are the only exception, with a second engineer's sign-off
Every deploy goes through staging with a smoke test before production, no exceptions for small changes

text:
Goodwill credits

Support can issue a goodwill credit of up to $75 per customer per quarter without approval. Anything above that requires a support manager's sign-off logged directly in the ticket before the credit goes out.

expected.description: Goodwill credits capped at $75 per customer per quarter without approval

text:
Breach notification decision

Once a data breach involving personal data is confirmed, we notify the relevant data protection regulator within 72 hours per GDPR Article 33. This is separate from internal CISO notification, which has to happen first, but the regulator clock runs on its own 72-hour deadline.

expected.description: Data breach notifications to regulators go out within 72 hours
Internal CISO notification must happen before regulator notification

text:
## Dependency upgrades

Dependency version bumps always go in their own pull request, separate from any feature or bugfix work. Never bundle a dependency upgrade into a PR that also changes product behavior -- it makes a bad diff to review and a bad diff to revert if the upgrade breaks something.

expected.description: Dependency upgrades go in their own PR, separate from feature work

text:
Travel

Book international travel for work only after getting written pre-approval from your manager, including destination and estimated cost. Domestic travel under the standard budget doesn't need pre-approval and can be booked directly.

expected.description: International travel requires manager pre-approval
Domestic travel under standard budget doesn't need pre-approval

text:
Churn risk decision

If an enterprise account shows two or more churn-risk signals -- usage drop, failed renewal call, executive sponsor departure -- in a rolling 30 days, notify the assigned customer success manager the same day the second signal lands.

expected.description: Two or more churn-risk signals in 30 days notify the CSM same day

text:
## API keys

Every service-to-service API key and customer-issued API key rotates on a 90-day schedule by default. Customers get a 14-day warning email before their key expires so integrations don't break unexpectedly on rotation day.

expected.description: API keys rotate every 90 days
Customers get a 14-day warning email before API key expiration

text:
Language routing

A ticket detected in a language other than English routes to the on-shift language specialist for that language instead of the general queue. If no specialist is on shift, hold the ticket rather than reply machine-translated -- a bad machine translation is worse than a delay.

expected.description: Non-English tickets route to a language specialist
Hold the ticket rather than sending a machine-translated reply when no specialist is on shift

text:
Security incident decision

Any confirmed security incident -- unauthorized access, data exposure, or credential compromise -- must reach the CISO within one hour of confirmation, before any public communication goes out to customers or press.

expected.description: Security incidents notify the CISO within one hour

text:
## Changelog

Every pull request that changes user-facing behavior needs a changelog entry added in the same PR, under the "Unreleased" heading. Internal refactors and test-only changes are exempt -- if a user wouldn't notice the change, it doesn't need an entry.

expected.description: User-facing PRs need a changelog entry in the same PR

text:
Reopening tickets

A customer replying to a resolved ticket within 7 days reopens the original ticket instead of creating a new one, which preserves history for the agent. After 7 days, any reply starts a fresh ticket rather than reopening the old one.

expected.description: Resolved tickets reopen within 7 days of a customer reply

text:
Offboarding decision

When an employee's last day is confirmed, IT must revoke all system access -- SSO, VPN, shared drives, admin panels -- within 24 hours. Manager notification of departure triggers the revocation ticket automatically, no separate request needed.

expected.description: Offboarded employees have access revoked within 24 hours
Manager notification of departure automatically triggers the revocation ticket

text:
# Acme Widgets

Acme Widgets is a fast, friendly way to manage your team's widgets from one dashboard. Built with a modern stack and a focus on speed, it gets out of your way so you can ship. Check out the demo, star the repo if you find it useful, and join our Discord to chat with the team.

## v2.4.1

- Fixed a crash when opening the settings panel on a fresh install
- Improved load time for the dashboard by roughly 200ms
- Updated the icon set to match the new brand guidelines
- Minor copy fixes across onboarding screens

Getting started

After signing up, you'll land on the dashboard where you can connect your first data source. From there you can browse templates, invite teammates, and explore the report builder. Most teams are up and running within a few minutes.

Brainstorm notes (2026-02-14)

Discussed a few directions for the Q2 roadmap: a mobile app, deeper Slack integration, and a public API. No decisions made -- everyone agreed to come back next week with rough sizing estimates before picking a direction.

## Architecture

The app is a monorepo with a Next.js frontend, a FastAPI backend, and a Postgres database. Background jobs run on a separate worker process. We use Redis for caching and a message queue for async processing between services.

What is Acme Widgets?

Acme Widgets helps teams track and manage physical inventory across multiple warehouses. It replaces spreadsheets with a shared, searchable system that updates in real time as items move.

Standup notes

Alex is finishing up the search reindex work, should land by Friday. Priya is blocked on design review for the new settings page. Sam is investigating the flaky checkout test before picking up new work.

## Acknowledgments

Thanks to everyone who has contributed issues, PRs, and feedback so far. Special thanks to the maintainers of the open source libraries this project builds on -- see NOTICE.md for the full list of licenses.

## v2.3.0

- Reduced bundle size by lazy-loading the chart library
- Sped up the search index rebuild for large workspaces
- Migrated the image pipeline to a newer codec for smaller file sizes
- General dependency updates

Glossary

Workspace: a top-level container for a team's data. Widget: a single trackable item within a workspace. View: a saved filter/sort configuration over a list of widgets. Snapshot: a point-in-time export of a workspace's full widget list.

# Data deletion requests

When a customer submits a verified data deletion request, support must complete the deletion across every system -- production database, backups, and analytics -- within 30 days of verification. A request is not closed until deletion is confirmed in writing to the customer.

## Comments

Confirmed with legal: the 30 day window starts at verification, not at the original request, since we sometimes need a few days to confirm identity.

expected.description: verified customer data deletion requests must be completed within 30 days of verification
A deletion request isn't closed until confirmed in writing to the customer
